item.title: Academic Projects at SJTU
item.description:
During my exchange period at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, I completed several coursework projects in materials science.
Unlike the lecture notes shown here, these are self-contained studies developed within specific course contexts, specifically with a stronger emphasis on modelling, analysis, or literature review.

The documents below are shared as originally submitted, with only minor adjustments where necessary.

Projects

• Modelling the Melting Behaviour of Pure Ni, Zr, and Ni-Zr Alloys

A molecular dynamics study (LAMMPS) of melting and phase transitions in pure Ni, Zr, and Ni-Zr intermetallics, with focus on atomistic-scale thermal behaviour.

item.title: LaTeX Notes for Politecnico di Milano
item.description:
I started using LaTeX in 2020, right at the beginning of my studies at Politecnico di Milano.
I was first introduced to it by a PhD student who showed a small group of us the basics; nothing too formal, just enough to get started.
That was enough to get me interested, and I ended up picking up the rest on my own.

My workflow started with TeXstudio, but I switched pretty quickly to Visual Studio Code, which I still use now. I rely on a few extensions (LaTeX Workshop, LaTeX language support, and a spell checker) which cover most of what I need without getting in the way.
